description:
Autopilot is a visual marketing automation platform that uses AI for journey mapping, segmentation, and personalized messaging across email, SMS, and in-app notifications.

Ortto’s marketing automation and customer data platform unifies your data, messaging and analytics on a single platform.

Visual journey mapping and automation. AI-powered audience segmentation. Personalized messaging across channels. Multi-channel campaign delivery.
